build_tree_from_path: build a tree structure by walking a directory path and capturing all files and subdirectories
compare_two_trees: compare two TreeNode instances and produce a TreeDifference listing added, removed, modified, and touched files
create_treenode_and_add_children: create a TreeNode directory node and add child file or directory nodes to it
traverse_tree_to_list: traverse a TreeNode and return a flat list of all file and directory names in the tree
print_tree_difference_report: print a formatted report of added, removed, modified, and touched files from a TreeDifference instance
